sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (McLain State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 8 non-electric sites (trailers/RVs to 30 ft) $38, 74 20/30-amp sites $43, 33 50-amp sites $48. The DNR's 2026 table: $41 (20/30-amp) / $46 (50-amp); the booking site's 2026 non-electric rate is $36. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($38 / $43 / $48 on 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21; $36 / $41 / $46 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (McLain campground $46 / $41) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain ('There is 30- and/or 50-amp electrical service available on each site'; tag 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (electric sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One modern campground in two sections: sites 1-91 smaller and along the Lake Superior shoreline, sites 100-135 bigger; most shaded. The booking site lists 115 sites (74 20/30-amp, 33 50-amp, 8 non-electric); electric sites take trailers/RVs to 50 ft, the non-electric ones to 30 ft. Also 6 mini cabins, a tiny house and a camper cabin.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain ('Number of sites: 114'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment up to 'Trailer or RV up to 50'' on the electric sites, 30' on the non-electric), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station', 'Concession or store'; 'The park's sanitation station is located in the modern campground. There is potable water available'; Sundae in the Park in the beach house sells 'camping supplies'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Rustic sites 72-77 and 88-91 are marked on the campground map as 'not reservable through the central reservation system'.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + campground map PDF (star legend: 'Sites not reservable through the central reservation system' on sites 72-77 and 88-91), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + campground map + booking site + DNR rates table: 114 sites (booking site 115), 20/30 A on every electric site and 50 A on 33, electric only, pull-throughs, RVs to 50 ft; showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station with potable water/concession store; reservable, with 10 star-marked rustic sites walk-up only. Fees 41-46 (2026 table) -> 38-48 (2027 booking site, low is the 8 non-electric drive-in sites to 30 ft; 2026 rates and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual) left as is. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page and the entry has no phone: the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mclain, phone 906-482-0278.

Pin: 47.2349,-88.6115 sits in the woods just south of M-203, about 100 m from the campground across the highway (Esri imagery, read 2026-10-22); the campground strip lies between M-203 and the Lake Superior shore, e.g. ~47.2362,-88.6115 at its west loop.
